/** Loader Optimization III. Regenerated by scripts/build-treasury-compat-loader.cjs.
 * Only reviewed definition modules are reused. Revision state, commitment module,
 * builder wrapper, observations and indexes remain per sample/build invocation.
 * Initialization stays lazy INSIDE the admitted sample's readerLoad budget.
 * No Game/Memory value, output/index/room/store or resource catalog is cached here.
 */
const COMPAT_REUSABLE_DEFINITION_IDS = Object.freeze([
  "src/runtime/configNormalize.ts",
  "src/runtime/logistics/resourceTransferTaskHealth.ts",
  "src/runtime/treasury/holderResolution.ts",
  "src/runtime/treasury/observation.ts",
  "src/runtime/treasury/ownerIdentity.ts",
  "src/runtime/treasury/types.ts",
]);
let compatReadDefinitions;
export function createCompatibilityReadCore(): CompatReadBuilders {
  // A failed first initialization never publishes a partly populated shared set.
  const shared = compatReadDefinitions;
  const cache = Object.create(null);
  function load(id) {
    if (shared && Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(shared, id)) return shared[id];
    if (Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(cache, id)) return cache[id];
    if (!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(factories, id)) throw new Error("unlisted read dependency");
    const exports = Object.create(null);
    cache[id] = exports;
    factories[id](exports, spec => {
      if (!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(dependencies[id], spec)) throw new Error("unlisted read import");
      return load(dependencies[id][spec]);
    });
    return exports;
  }
  const observation = load("src/runtime/treasury/observation.ts");
  // This module closes over commitmentRevision and constructs RESOURCES_ALL's
  // validation Set. BOTH factories deliberately run anew for every sample.
  const commitments = load("src/runtime/treasury/commitments.ts");
  const builders = Object.freeze({
    buildObservation: options => observation.buildTreasuryObservation(options),
    buildCommitments: options => commitments.buildTreasuryCommitmentIndex(options),
  });
  if (!shared) {
    const definitions = Object.create(null);
    for (const id of COMPAT_REUSABLE_DEFINITION_IDS) {
      if (!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(cache, id)) throw new Error("missing read definition");
      // Exports never escape the capsule. Nested constants are definition-only;
      // no returned observation/index or mutable sample state is stored here.
      definitions[id] = Object.freeze(cache[id]);
    }
    compatReadDefinitions = Object.freeze(definitions);
  }
  return builders;
}
